data.summary: Felix V grants a dispensation from personal residence to Peter Vial, rector of the parish church of Cloysia in the Diocese of Geneva, allowing him to retain the fruits and revenues of the benefice while serving as chaplain to Cardinal Francis of Saint Marcellus, provided a vicar is appointed to care for the church.
